Buzzard Attack Chopper is a small armed helicopter that combines missiles, machine guns, agility, and easy landing, making it one of Story Mode's most useful aircraft.
Frogger is a civilian helicopter suitable for transport and general exploration.
Maverick is a common civilian helicopter used for transport and aerial access around Los Santos.
P-996 LAZER is the military fighter jet based at Fort Zancudo. It is extremely fast and heavily armed but stealing it usually triggers an intense wanted response.
Western Besra is an agile unarmed jet useful for aerobatics and fast travel in supported Story Mode editions.
Cargobob is a heavy-lift helicopter with a cargo hook, used in several missions and useful for moving certain vehicles.
Michael's special ability slows time during gunfights, making precision aiming and headshots easier. It fits his strong starting Shooting stat and is especially useful in dense firefights.
Franklin's special ability slows time while driving and increases vehicle control. It is excellent for high-speed chases, avoiding collisions, cornering, and drive-by situations.
Trevor's special ability puts him into a rage state where he deals more damage and becomes much harder to kill. It is ideal for close-range combat and heavy firefights.
Each protagonist has separate Special, Stamina, Shooting, Strength, Stealth, Flying, Driving, and Lung Capacity stats. Skills improve through relevant activities rather than spending skill points.

how wanted levels work gta v

Wanted levels measure police response. More stars bring stronger law-enforcement units and tactics. To escape, break line of sight, leave the search area, avoid being seen again, and wait for the wanted stars to clear.
GTA V's maximum normal wanted level is five stars. At high levels the response becomes extremely aggressive, with heavy police presence, tactical units, helicopters, and roadblocks.
Entering Fort Zancudo without mission authorization normally triggers a high wanted level and military response. Stealing military aircraft is therefore risky without a prepared escape plan.

For general Story Mode use, the Carbine Rifle is one of the safest all-round choices because it is accurate, controllable, and versatile. The Advanced Rifle offers strong damage and fire rate later in the story, while preference can depend on range and recoil tolerance.
The Assault Shotgun is one of the strongest close-range Story Mode weapons because it combines high fire rate with strong stopping power. It becomes available later in the campaign.
The Heavy Sniper is the strongest long-range sniper option in Story Mode once unlocked, while the standard Sniper Rifle is available earlier and is easier to obtain for mid-game missions.

The best heavy weapon depends on the target: the Minigun delivers sustained fire, the RPG is excellent against vehicles and clustered targets, and the Grenade Launcher offers explosive fire with a different trajectory and reload rhythm.

For drive-by combat, compact one-handed weapons are the practical choice. The Micro SMG is useful early, while the AP Pistol becomes a very strong vehicle weapon once available.

Sticky Bombs become available after Friends Reunited and are useful for planned vehicle destruction, traps, and mission objectives.
The RPG becomes available in Ammu-Nation after Blitz Play, alongside several other heavier combat options.

For mission vehicles, prioritize armor and bulletproof tires for survivability, then engine, brakes, transmission, and turbo for performance. A protagonist's signature vehicle is a good investment because it reliably returns.

The signature vehicles are Franklin's Buffalo S, Michael's Tailgater, and Trevor's Bodhi. These vehicles are persistent and normally return with their owner, making them safer to customize than random stolen cars.
where lost car goes gta v

If a recent personal or stored vehicle is abandoned rather than destroyed, it may appear at the Mission Row police impound. The impound only retains a limited number of recent vehicles, so it is not reliable long-term storage.

Stealth mode reduces noise and makes quiet movement easier. The Stealth stat improves by moving in stealth and performing silent takedowns, but GTA V's missions often mix scripted detection with free-roam stealth mechanics.
Strength improves melee damage, climbing speed, sport performance, and resistance to some damage. It rises through melee hits and certain sports activities.
Stamina increases by running, swimming, and cycling. Higher Stamina lets a protagonist perform strenuous movement for longer before tiring.
Shooting improves through successful hits and headshots, and the Ammu-Nation shooting range is an efficient way to train it. Higher Shooting reduces recoil and improves weapon handling.
Flying improves through time spent controlling aircraft and through Flight School. Higher Flying makes aircraft more stable and easier to handle in turbulence, takeoffs, and landings.
Driving improves through skilled vehicle use such as wheelies, controlled jumps, and clean high-speed driving. Franklin already starts with the strongest Driving stat.

Using cheats disables achievements or trophies for the current play session and can interfere with medal attempts. Reloading a clean save/session removes the temporary cheat state; cheats do not permanently corrupt the completion percentage by themselves.
how mission gold works gta v

Gold medals come from completing optional mission objectives. They are not required for 100% completion. Mission objectives can be completed across replays rather than necessarily all in one perfect run.

Story missions can be replayed from the pause menu to chase medals or revisit content. Replaying a mission does not rewrite the permanent choices of the current save, such as a different final ending.

If no Story Mode mission appears, Rockstar recommends trying all three protagonists, spending some in-game time doing other activities, moving around to allow phone calls to trigger, and testing a new Quick Save slot. In some cases a taxi skip can force a useful loading transition. A genuinely corrupt save may require an older save.

On PC, Story Mode saves are handled through the Rockstar Games Launcher environment and are separate from GTA Online character progression.

The 100% checklist is divided into five groups: all 69 Story Mode missions, the required Franklin Strangers & Freaks content, 42 hobbies and pastimes, any 14 random events, and 16 miscellaneous tasks.
what are strangers and freaks gta v

Strangers & Freaks are optional character-based side missions marked by question-mark icons. They introduce eccentric NPCs such as Tonya, Hao, Beverly, Dom, Omega, Maude, Barry, and the Epsilon Program characters.
Random Events are short free-roam encounters that appear while traveling. Many involve helping or confronting NPCs. Only 14 are required for 100% completion, although many more exist.
